Strict separation from C to a point before or after the line section gives respectively F=0 or G=0 with the correct signs. The cumulative mass is continuous with the exact two tails, giving a nonatomic measure supported on the line section.
Right and left closed rays have masses k−B(t) and B(t), bounded respectively by G(t) and F(t). A parallel cap contains the line or misses it. No boundary atom changes either ray.
Two opposite perpendicular caps yield 2k≤1. A median of the continuous line cumulative mass attains depth k/2 and the opposite rays bound the depth at any line point by k/2.
